statement: Grid-transversal theorems G.1--G.3. For d>=3 and d-1 disjoint prime pools of size m, the complete family of injected K_(d-1,d) row-column product relations is support-minimal and satisfies the exact marginal inequality |D_row|/binom(m,d)+d|D_col|/m^(d-1)>=1 for every transversal. If delta*m>=2d(d-1) and m>2^d*d!*delta^(-d), its transversal number lies between (1-delta)m^(d-1) and m^(d-1). With d=floor(sqrt(log N/log log N)), primes in (N^(1/d)/2,N^(1/d)], and delta=(log N)^(-1/4), this embeds in H_N and gives log tau(H_N)>=log N-(2+o(1))sqrt(log N log log N), with all vertices above N^(1-1/d)/2^(d-1). The same bound charges arbitrary global repair and yields Pr(random D is a transversal)<=E|D|/T for the explicit finite threshold T.
dependency_gaps: The all-N arithmetic embedding uses the ordinary prime number theorem in the form pi(x)-pi(x/2)=(1+o(1))x/(2 log x).
Independent blind reconstruction has not yet been performed; the author-side finite replay is not independent verification.
